crash_events.description: Near-miss event. A white van, waiting in the left lane at a roundabout entrance, abruptly pulls out into the dashcam vehicle's lane, cutting in front to enter the roundabout. The dashcam vehicle was stationary and had to remain so to avoid a collision.

summary: The video captures one near-miss event at a roundabout. A white van unsafely changed lanes directly in front of the stationary dashcam vehicle to enter the roundabout, creating a significant risk of collision. No actual impact occurred.
